biological_meaning: minimum legitimate visit rate per flower-minute worth being able to detect
source_metric: legitimate pollinator visits per flower per 30 min
production_rule: do not infer an exact production minimum from a plotted mean; numeric use requires raw/tabulated exact source value plus context-transport justification, or fresh independent natural-history calibration
next_action: recover exact underlying visitation values if available; otherwise estimate the minimum-relevance anchor prospectively in a disjoint fresh calibration
notes: 2015 used 30-min censuses and counted simultaneously open flowers, so the denominator structure is transportable after conversion to flower-minutes; exact baseline means are not tabulated in searchable text

biological_meaning: probability of at least one legitimate pollinator detection when the true rate equals the frozen minimum relevant rate
production_rule: freeze prospectively; increasing the requested probability may only increase required flower-minute exposure
next_action: choose and document the prospective detection probability before P0 outcomes
notes: not estimated from historical or screen outcomes

biological_meaning: minimum number and duration of observation bouts preventing a single short time window from defining context
source_metric: 2015 alternated morning/afternoon 30-min plot censuses over 20-30 h per year
target_metric: prospective bout count and minutes per bout
production_rule: historical schedule is a natural-history anchor; production coverage remains a predeclared design decision for the focal site/season
next_action: freeze bout count/minimum duration with explicit diel/phenological coverage rationale
notes: separate from total flower-minute detection exposure

biological_meaning: minimum early attacked-flower or oviposition prevalence worth being able to detect
source_metric: fruit predation and/or final seed predation proportions
production_rule: final seed/fruit predation cannot be copied into an early-attack P0 prevalence threshold; historical variation is a reality anchor only
next_action: measure early attack/oviposition prevalence on a disjoint natural-history calibration set before P0 production freeze
notes: 2013 and 2016 show strong density/year/population dependence; 2015 seed predation ranged widely among populations

biological_meaning: probability of at least one early attacked flower when true prevalence equals the frozen minimum relevant prevalence
production_rule: freeze prospectively; planner converts it to screened-flower count
notes: zero detection after completed frozen effort remains context-uninformative

biological_meaning: minimum fraction of flowering plants carrying a functional measurable cupulate-bract water state during the screen window
source_metric: functional water-holding state and water-drainage effect; no population prevalence denominator
target_metric: fraction of flowering plants water-positive at the registered screen moment
production_rule: functional reality does not identify prevalence; do not infer a percentage from statements that bracts usually contain water
next_action: measure water-positive prevalence on a disjoint fresh natural-history calibration set under the registered timing/weather definition
notes: water state is rainfall- and timing-dependent, so current prevalence must be calibrated

biological_meaning: probability of at least one water-positive plant at the frozen minimum relevant prevalence
production_rule: freeze prospectively; planner converts it to plant count
notes: zero after completed effort remains context-uninformative

biological_meaning: reserve above the disjoint Y-CAL 36 + D0-CAL 48 base plant floor
production_rule: freeze reserve fraction before site census; census stops at required capacity or must exhaust the focal population
next_action: choose reserve based on anticipated field loss/phenotype-screening burden before seeing site census
notes: base 84 is fixed by downstream design; reserve remains a prospective operational choice
